describe: The image shows a cut-out tree with a wide, spreading canopy. Dark olive-green and near-black leaf masses form the top, with lighter green-yellow highlights on the upper left. Thin dark branches fork downward, and two slender grey-green trunks rise from the bottom. Transparent background: the flat mid-grey area around the tree is transparent. Lighting is dim and even, with medium contrast between the canopy highlights and the dark branches.
